---
title: "Ask Aaron"
description: "A retrieval-augmented assistant that answers questions about my work, research and projects."
---

Ask about my work history, research, data engineering projects or skills.
The assistant retrieves from a curated knowledge base of my CV, publications
and project documentation, routes each question to the right collection and
answers with citations from the retrieved material.

::: {.callout-note}
The app scales to zero when idle, so the first question after a quiet period
takes about 30 seconds to wake it up. After that it responds normally.
:::

## How it works

Questions are classified into one of three routes (work history, my own
research, or the related literature), each backed by its own vector
collection. Retrieval-relevant chunks are shown alongside every answer, so
you can see exactly what the model was given. The pipeline is Python,
ChromaDB and Claude, deployed on Cloud Run.
